focus: Upper Body Push & Lower Body Quadriceps

exercises.name: Incline Chair Push-Ups
exercises.instructions: Hands placed securely on the chair seat, core tight, chest lowers toward chair

exercises.name: Chair Box Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, sit back until glutes lightly touch chair seat, stand up driven by heels

exercises.name: Mat Glute Bridges
exercises.instructions: Lying on mat with knees bent, squeeze glutes and lift hips upward without arching lower back

exercises.name: Bird-Dog Holds
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg straight; hold steady while keeping abdominal wall braced
